ios.desc:
Effortlessly Track Playtime, Manage Substitutions, and Keep Score!

Take the stress out of tracking playtime, managing substitutions, and keeping score. Designed for coaches, parents, and volunteers, this app ensures every player gets their fair share of time on the field while keeping your team organized and game-ready.

Whether you're managing soccer, basketball, street hockey, or any other team sport, this all-in-one tool makes it easy to focus on the game—not the logistics.

Key Features:
Fair Playtime Tracking – Automatically monitor each player’s time on the field to ensure equal opportunities.
Smart Substitution Management – Automatically suggests which players should sub in and out based on playtime, ensuring fair rotations without the coach having to think about it. Keeps track of who’s been on the field and who’s waiting on the bench.
Player Lock – Keep specific players in the game or on the bench based on the situation. Whether it's for strategy, injury, or a quick break, Player Lock gives you control when you need it.
Integrated Scoreboard – Track scores and game segments in real time, all from the same app.
Player & Bench Counters – Keep tabs on who's in, who's out, and manage rotations effortlessly.
Easy Team Roster Management – Add, remove, and organize players on the fly.
Post-Game Reports – Automatically generate and share a detailed summary of playtime, including individual minutes played and average team playtime, so parents stay informed.
Multi-Sport Compatibility – Perfect for soccer, basketball, hockey, and more.
Intuitive Design – A simple, user-friendly interface built for quick access during live games.

Keep your team organized, ensure fairness, and focus on what really matters—helping kids enjoy the game.

quotes.text: First attempt at an iOS app, I wrote it for my Sons recreational soccer team.  We were trying to use a piece of paper to manage the substitutions, but the reality never matched the plan as kids got hurt, complained they were tired,  people don’t show up or the kids actually manage to keep the ball in bounds and there aren’t enough play stoppages to do the substitutions.
